flows.title: Set custom instructions
steps: On the web or in the desktop app, open Settings and select Personalization.
Make sure Enable customization is toggled on.
Enter your instructions in the Custom Instructions field. They apply immediately across all chats, including existing conversations.
Free and Go accounts can store up to 1,500 characters of custom instructions; Plus, Pro, Enterprise, Business and Education accounts up to 5,000.

flows.title: Share a conversation as a link
steps: Open the conversation you want to share.
Review the conversation and any sharing options that appear, because anyone permitted to open the link can see what it holds.
Select Create link or Copy link, whichever option is shown.
Send the link to the person who should see it. A shared conversation link begins with https://chatgpt.com/share/.

flows.title: Find and remove a shared link
steps: For Shared links, select Manage. The list holds shared conversation links and shared scheduled task links.
Select Delete shared link for one item, or open More actions and select Delete all shared links.
Removing a link stops future access through it and leaves the original conversation or task in place.
